No. 1924/39 – THURSDAY, JUJY 23, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry No.: L/03J/95/FR/154.

I hereby give notice, under sub section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude for public purpose (the conservation of Dumbara mountain range.)

Description of the Land /servitude to be acquired: An allotment of land called “Winchfield park Watta” “bearing an extent of about 4.2745 Hectares mentioned in P.P.Maha 6361, Supplement of the surveyor General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of Karambakatiya, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Udadumbara of Kandy District, Central Province.
Name and address of Claimants: Mr. K. A. P. Chandralal Perera — No. 211/A, Temple Road, Akarawita, Gampaha.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude on which is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Udadumbara, on the 05th August, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 29th July,

2015 nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
M. G. A. THILAKARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Udadumbara. Divisional Secretariat, Udadumbara. 24th June, 2015. 08 -179

G. H. M. A. PREMASINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Panwila. Divisional Secretariat, Panwila. 08th July, 2015. 08 -180
